verdict.summary: The change is a narrowly scoped research verification record, not an implementation or soundness certification. Its claims are consistently qualified as source/diff-derived and unmeasured, it explicitly preserves the sq-qhy4 external-review caveat, and it records the missing live failure-path test, Brillig message-path uncertainty, and absent measurement as blockers before the upstream draft is advanced. The summary added to the optimization program matches the detailed record, including the limited patch-application check and the fact that snapshot files, PR discussion, and runtime behavior were not reviewed. No security issue, vacuous claim of test coverage, or unqualified soundness/performance assertion is introduced.
